scripts.ios: udid=$(xcrun simctl list devices 'iOS 26.0' | awk -F '[()]' '/iPhone 17 Pro/{print $2; exit}'); test -n "$udid" || (echo 'No iOS 26 iPhone 17 Pro simulator found' && exit 1); xcrun simctl shutdown all >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; xcrun simctl boot "$udid" 2>/dev/null || true; open -a Simulator --args -CurrentDeviceUDID "$udid"; NODE_OPTIONS=--dns-result-order=ipv4first expo start --ios --localhost
